items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: Louis asked me to come down from the band.

ctx.x: When was this now? Um... Still in the thirties? Forties? Forties? Yeah.

It had Louie Russell's band back then. Um... Um... Because Louie used to be a band all the time. He would... Well, he would sing all things. He would sing all things. He would sing all things by himself. He would tell you what he would be. And Louie Russell's band kept going on. So they came from here and Louie told me, Sabbath one, he said, Oh, the phone had a... I said, man, Sabbath one. They had two bands tonight. Their band was playing out again. They were sitting in the desk. And he said, They were talking…
That is quite a compliment. It was, you see.
